title: Problem with hot addWidget
body:
Hi,

I have discovered an issue with adding widgets when there is a search query. Adding a new widget clears my query, but not any selected refinements. This can be seen  [here](https://hattonsdev.azurewebsites.net/collections/all) if you type something into the searchbar and then click on the 'subtype' facet. Clicking on this fires an event listener that loads the facet using search.addWidget, but it also clears the query.

If there is a query in the search on page load, (ie refreshing the page when there is something in the searchbar), opening the facet will set the query back to that value. This only seems to affect the query and not any of the other facets.
